name: tasksync
description: TaskSync — real-time collaborative task management platform (monorepo root)

scripts.//---format---: Run Prettier across every workspace from the repo root
scripts.//---lint---: Delegate to each workspace's own lint script
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.//---verify---: What CI runs — formatting + lint + types in one shot
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
